Name: Finance Skill
Author: MarsXsyper
Description:
[b][size=4]DESCRIPTION[/size][/b]
Finance Skill adds a new custom skill to Stardew Valley focused on the financial side of farm life.
Earn Finance experience from eligible income, increase your items’ sell prices as you level up, and choose professions that introduce Prize Tickets, passive income, credit, cashback, and purchase discounts.
The skill features 10 levels, two level 5 professions, and four branching level 10 professions.

[size=4][b]MAIN FEATURES[/b][/size]
• Each Finance level increases item sell prices by 1%, up to +10% at level 10.
• Six professions across two progression paths:
[list]
[*]Couponist → Passive Income or Coupon Master[/*]
[*]Credit Card → Cashbacker or Loyalty Program[/*]
[/list]• Receive Prize Tickets through Couponist and redeem three rewards per ticket with Coupon Master.
• Generate daily passive income based on your wallet balance.
• Use a credit system with credit limits, debt, monthly interest, automatic repayment, and a dedicated HUD.
• Choose between wallet-first payments and full credit card payments.
• Credit support for regular shops, backpack upgrades, Robin and Wizard buildings, house and cabin upgrades, community upgrades, and Marnie’s animal purchases.
• Support for compatible modded shops and buildings that use the supported vanilla purchase systems.
• Purchase prices reflect credit surcharges or Loyalty Program discounts, with red pricing when credit is used.
• Purchased-item tracking prevents Finance XP from being earned by reselling purchased items.
• Optional Generic Mod Config Menu support for payment buttons, HUD visibility, mouse dragging, fixed X/Y positioning, and purchased-item counters.
• English, Brazilian Portuguese, Spanish, and Russian translations.
• Custom profession icons and a Coupon Master reward interface with gamepad support.
• Designed for Stardew Valley 1.6. Requires SMAPI and SpaceCore.

FINANCE PROGRESSION
Eligible income grants Finance experience equal to 1% of the amount received. Fractional experience carries over toward future gains.
Purchased items do not grant Finance XP when resold, shipped, or recycled through the trash can. Passive Income and Cashbacker payouts also do not grant Finance XP.
Purchased quantities are tracked within mixed stacks. Legitimate units are consumed first, allowing their income to grant XP normally. Items transformed into a different product can grant XP normally.
Every Finance level increases item sell prices by 1%, reaching a +10% bonus at level 10.

PROFESSION TREE
Level 5: Couponist
Level 10: Passive Income or Coupon Master
Level 5: Credit Card
Level 10: Cashbacker or Loyalty Program

COUPONIST
Level 5 Profession
Gain a 5% chance to receive a Prize Ticket by mail each morning.
Prize Tickets can be used at the Prize Machine in Mayor Lewis’ house.
Choosing Couponist unlocks Passive Income and Coupon Master at level 10.

PASSIVE INCOME
Level 10 — Requires Couponist
Receive 10% of your current wallet balance every morning.
There is no additional payout cap beyond the game’s money limits. This payout does not grant Finance XP.

COUPON MASTER
Level 10 — Requires Couponist
Unlock an enhanced Prize Machine interface in Mayor Lewis’ house.
Each Prize Ticket grants three consecutive rewards from the machine’s normal reward progression instead of one. The interface previews your next three rewards.
Each reward advances the Prize Machine normally. Coupon Master does not use a separate reward table or bypass its progression.
The custom interface supports gamepad controls.

CREDIT CARD
Level 5 Profession
Make supported purchases using credit when your wallet cannot cover the cost, or choose to finance the entire purchase.
Your total credit limit equals 20% of your highest recorded income during a completed month. Available credit is your total limit minus your outstanding debt.
For example, a highest recorded monthly income of 100,000g establishes a total credit limit of 20,000g.
Your highest recorded monthly income never decreases.

PAYMENT OPTIONS
• Coin mode uses your wallet first and automatically finances any remaining cost with credit.
• Card mode charges the entire purchase to credit, preserving your wallet balance.
• Coin mode is selected automatically whenever you open a supported shop or construction menu.
• Backpack and supported upgrade dialogues offer separate wallet-first and full-credit purchase choices.
By default, the credit-funded portion receives a 10% surcharge. Available credit must cover the resulting charge.
Materials and other purchase requirements remain necessary. Credit covers the money cost only.

DEBT AND MONTHLY INTEREST
Debt persists until it is repaid. Incoming earnings automatically repay outstanding debt before the remaining amount stays in your wallet.
At the start of a new month, remaining debt receives 15% interest.
When monthly interest is applied, the card becomes locked. Additional credit is unavailable until the entire outstanding debt has been repaid.
The card unlocks automatically when the debt reaches zero.

CASHBACKER
Level 10 — Requires Credit Card
Receive cashback the following morning based on the previous day’s credit-funded purchases.
Cashback equals 25% of the financed principal, excluding the credit surcharge. Amounts paid directly from your wallet do not count.
Cashback does not grant Finance XP or count toward the monthly income used to calculate your credit limit.

LOYALTY PROGRAM
Level 10 — Requires Credit Card
Remove the normal 10% credit surcharge and receive a 5% discount on the credit-funded portion of purchases.
Amounts paid directly from your wallet retain their normal price.

PURCHASE COMPATIBILITY
Credit is supported for:
• Regular shop purchases.
• Backpack upgrades.
• Robin and Wizard buildings.
• House and cabin upgrades.
• Community upgrades.
• Marnie’s animal purchases.
Compatible modded shops, buildings, and animals can use the same support when they follow the supported vanilla purchase systems. Custom purchase systems implemented by other mods may require additional compatibility.
Displayed prices account for applicable surcharges or profession discounts. Red pricing indicates that the purchase uses credit.

HUD AND CONFIGURATION
The credit HUD displays available credit and outstanding debt. Its default position is below the quest button beneath the money display.
With Generic Mod Config Menu, you can:
• Show or hide payment buttons.
• Show or hide the credit HUD.
• Enable or disable HUD dragging.
• Set the HUD’s X/Y coordinates.
• Show purchased-unit counters in item stacks.
When dragging is enabled, hold either mouse button over the HUD to move it. The chosen position is saved automatically.
The optional purchased-item display shows a red counter on stacks containing purchased units and adds the exact purchased quantity to the item description.
Generic Mod Config Menu is optional.

LANGUAGES
• English
• Brazilian Portuguese
• Spanish
• Russian
Translations follow the game’s selected language, with English as the fallback.

[size=4][b]Future Plans[/b][/size]
-Adding ACTUAL coupons to use with the couponist and coupon master abilities.
-Adding new books that expand the skill effects and grant Finance XP.
-Giving more freedom and ways to use the Credit Card system.
-And more? All and any suggestions are welcome.


[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

Stardew Valley 1.6
SMAPI
SpaceCore


[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]

1. Install SMAPI.
2. Install SpaceCore.
3. Download Finance Skill.
4. Extract the "Finance Skill" folder into your Stardew Valley "Mods" folder.
5. Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.
